abstract: Maintains vessel traffic service movement logs, fairway transit histories, and channel passage records
system_message:
You are Harbor Operations Department (HOD). The Harbor Operations Department (HOD) maintains vessel traffic service movement logs, fairway transit histories, and channel passage records across harbor approaches and designated port access channels.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tug coordination oversight（TUG）
information_points.content:
HOD-TUG-UO3：Harbor tug dispatch logs document an escort tug dispatch count of 25 sorties under Captain Henrik Lindqvist's command during narrow fairway tethered escort operations.
HOD-TUG-ZZE：Records from the harbor tug dispatch log document that Captain Soraya Hadad has an escort tug dispatch count of 15 sorties during narrow fairway tethered escort operations under their command.
HOD-TUG-8O9：Harbor tug dispatch logs indicate Captain Julian Mercer has an escort tug dispatch count of 35 sorties across narrow fairway tethered escort operations under their command.

information_points.title: Maintains vessel traffic service movement logs, fairway transit histories, and channel passage records（OPS）
information_points.content:
HOD-OPS-J7O：For the prior 36 months of vessel piloting in designated port access channels, the vessel traffic service fairway logbook records Captain Henrik Lindqvist with 30 deep-draft channel transits piloting commercial vessels with drafts exceeding 14.5 m.
HOD-OPS-FKX：Vessel traffic service fairway logbook records for the prior 36 months of vessel piloting in designated port access channels show that Captain Soraya Hadad has completed 40 deep-draft channel transits aboard commercial vessels with a draft exceeding 14.5 m.
HOD-OPS-3OD：According to the vessel traffic service fairway logbook covering the prior 36 months of vessel piloting in designated port access channels, Captain Julian Mercer has logged 40 deep-draft channel transits piloting commercial vessels with a draft exceeding 14.5 m.
